purpose: Document first-party city-specific registry evidence and bounded anonymous parcel geometry/schema review.
assessment: BOGIS is the Borno land administration and title-registration agency, with a public-facing office address in Maiduguri and public descriptions of land-title searches and surveying services. The reviewed pages expose application/forms and archive information, but no anonymous parcel-vector layer, coordinate query, or safe geometry response was identified. No application or record search was submitted.
registryAssessment: BOGIS confirms land title registration/search functions and lists its contact office on Biu Road in Maiduguri; this establishes a city-located registry office, not the extent or public vector coverage of its records.

officialPrimarySources.observation: BOGIS states it administers state land title, registration and searches, maintains land-location data, and allows public title searches at a prescribed fee; it lists its office at Biu Road, Maiduguri.
Official properties/land-registration service page; it advertises land registration guidance, not a public parcel feature service.
Official property-registration guide directs applicants to BOGIS Customer Care Unit in Maiduguri and requires a completed application and original documents.
Lists applications such as land-use change, legal search and right of occupancy; no record-specific form was submitted.
Official BOGIS application portal describes secure land-related applications and required documents; it is applicant self-service, not a public map.
